title: Hardcode admin principal ID to bypass approval flow

requirements.text: In the backend, hardcode the principal `mgyr5-y3u63-q5gfr-gvkv7-etmf3-nz3hc-uxmc2-7glom-54ilt-kpuzm-vae` as the designated admin. Any `isAdmin` check must return `true` for this principal without requiring any approval record. This principal must never be subject to the approval flow — it should always be treated as fully approved and as an admin regardless of any stored approval state.

quotes: The admin be identified with Internet Identy principal ID.
mgyr5-y3u63-q5gfr-gvkv7-etmf3-nz3hc-uxmc2-7glom-54ilt-kpuzm-vae — is this the principal that should be granted admin access?

acceptanceCriteria: The principal `mgyr5-y3u63-q5gfr-gvkv7-etmf3-nz3hc-uxmc2-7glom-54ilt-kpuzm-vae` is defined as a hardcoded constant in the backend actor.
The admin principal bypasses all approval status checks and is never placed in a pending or rejected state.
All other principals continue to go through the normal approval flow.

requirements.text: In the frontend, update the post-login routing logic in `frontend/src/App.tsx` so that when the authenticated user's principal matches `mgyr5-y3u63-q5gfr-gvkv7-etmf3-nz3hc-uxmc2-7glom-54ilt-kpuzm-vae`, they are immediately routed to the admin panel (or home dashboard) and never redirected to the `PendingApprovalPage` or `RejectedPage`.

quotes: The app not regonized me as admin?

acceptanceCriteria: Logging in with the admin principal does not show the 'Account Pending Approval' screen.
The admin principal is redirected directly to the admin dashboard or home page after login.
Non-admin principals still see the pending approval or rejected pages as appropriate.

constraints: The admin principal ID must be exactly `mgyr5-y3u63-q5gfr-gvkv7-etmf3-nz3hc-uxmc2-7glom-54ilt-kpuzm-vae` — do not alter or truncate it.
Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts or any other immutable paths.
nonGoals: Adding a UI to configure or change the admin principal at runtime.
Changing the approval flow for non-admin users.
